# Steelers select Buggs in sixth round

#  Steelers select Buggs in sixth round  
Apr 27, 2019 at 04:05 PM  
*   *   *   * Copied!  
**Isaiah Buggs
Defensive End
Alabama
6-3, 295
Ruston, La.
Ruston High School
6th Round â 192nd Overall**  
**CAREER NOTES**
Played in 29 games at Alabama from 2017-18, producing 102 total tackles (44 solo), 11.0 sacks, 17.5 tackles for loss, three passes defensed, two forced fumbles and one fumble recoveryâ¦transferred to Alabama from Mississippi Gulf Coast Community College where he earned All-MACJC South Division honors in 2015 and 2016.  
**2018 SEASON**

# Steelers select Buggs in sixth round

**2018 SEASON**
Earned second team All-America honors from the AFCAâ¦named to the All-SEC second team by the _Associated Press_ and conference coachesâ¦sack leader of the Tide defense that finished tied for 10th in the nation in sacks per game (3.0) with 45.0 totalâ¦contributed a team-best 9.5 sacks (-49 yards), finishing fourth in the SEC in the categoryâ¦generated 51 tackles, six quarterback hurries, three pass breakups, two forced fumble and one fumble recoveryâ¦selected as the SEC Defensive Player of the Week for his efforts vs. Texas A&M (Sept. 22), setting career high marks in sacks (3.5) and four tackles for lossâ¦had three tackles with 1.5 sacks and a forced fumble against Missouri (Oct. 13)â¦tied for second on the team with six tackles in the national title game vs. Clemson (Jan. 7).  
**2017 SEASON**

# Steelers select Buggs in sixth round

**2017 SEASON**
Started 13-of-14 games played in his first season at Alabamaâ¦tallied 51 tackles with 1.5 sacks, four tackles for loss and tied for second on the defense with seven quarterback pressuresâ¦ had a career-high four tackles and a quarterback hurry vs. Colorado State (Sept. 16)â¦collected a half-sack, the first of his career, along with three tackles and two quarterback hurries vs. Ole Miss (Sept. 30)â¦led the Crimson Tide with a career-best 10 total tackles against Texas A&M (Oct. 7)â¦had a team high seven tackles vs. Tennessee (Oct. 21)â¦collected three tackles, including 1.0 sack as part of the defense's five in the Sugar Bowl vs. Clemson (Jan. 1)â¦had five tackles, including one stop for loss vs. Georgia in the national championship game (Jan. 8).  
**2016 SEASON**
Totaled 75 tackles, including 10 stops for loss and 3.5 sacks at Mississippi Gulf Coast Community College.  
**2015 SEASON**

# Steelers select Buggs in sixth round

**2016 SEASON**
Totaled 75 tackles, including 10 stops for loss and 3.5 sacks at Mississippi Gulf Coast Community College.  
**2015 SEASON**
Generated 59 tackles, eight for loss, and 4.0 sacks in freshman campaign at Mississippi Gulf Coast Community College.  
**HIGH SCHOOL**
Played at Ruston (Ruston, La.) High School.
